The bagel has a distinct twisted or braided shape rather than a perfect smooth ring, with a significant portion of the top covered in dense poppy seeds and a section revealing the golden-brown crust and lighter interior dough. In the background, there is a blurred loaf of bread or another baked good.

The inner edge of the bagel hole lacks a clean, defined rim. The dough seems to bulge inward irregularly, and the transition between the seed-covered top and the inner wall is somewhat muddy and indistinct.
The background object is heavily blurred. While this mimics depth of field, the blur pattern is slightly unnatural and lacks coherent structure, typical of AI-generated backgrounds.
